environment.description: Lambda function invoked via API Gateway (HTTP API) configured with a VPC Link to an internal NLB. The execute-api endpoint has a resource policy denying all traffic except from the VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint for execute-api (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api) has a custom endpoint policy restricting invoke access to IAM principals within the same AWS Organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). Security groups on the VPC endpoint ENIs restrict inbound to port 443 from CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 only. DNS is configured with private hosted zone overriding execute-api DNS to resolve to VPC endpoint IPs. No public DNS resolution exists for the API. The NLB target group performs health checks but does not modify or inject headers. Route tables in the VPC have no internet gateway or NAT gateway routes for the subnets hosting the endpoint ENIs.
